quickStart.title: Read a Kafka topic
quickStart.description: Change the topic and broker to match your Kafka cluster. The returned columns describe the messages in that topic.
quickStart.note: Rows depend on the topic. SQL LIMIT caps displayed rows; review scan settings for offsets, partitions, and consumption behavior before using a large or active topic.
quickStart.requirements: Provide a reachable Kafka broker and an existing topic. The local address below assumes you already have Kafka running.

notice.title: A successor extension is on the way
notice.body: Tributary is the right tool today for reading Kafka topics from DuckDB — snapshots, joins, and cluster inspection all work. A more capable successor is in active development that will add producer support, Avro and Protobuf Schema Registry support, and transactional semantics. Subscribe below and we'll email you the moment it ships, with a migration note.

introduction.title: Read Kafka messages as rows
paragraphs: Apache Kafka stores streams of messages in topics. Tributary lets a DuckDB query consume records from a topic, inspect their contents, and save or join them using SQL.

Use it to investigate messages, take a bounded snapshot, or combine a topic’s data with reference tables. You supply the broker, topic, and consumer configuration, including authentication where required. Reading a topic with a query does not automatically keep a local table synchronized with future messages.
